description: Two-seat match: conquest on Mainland between two external agents with no built-in AI, decided by turn 12000 or drawn.

objective.success: Each seat's result: win, draw, or loss; administrative outcomes are recorded separately.
objective.public: Two-player match against another agent controlling the other civilisation. Win by conquest: destroy or capture all enemy conquest-critical entities before turn 12000. Reaching the turn limit is a draw. Both players receive their observations from the same completed turn and their orders enter the game together.
